name: musashi RNA binding protein 1

function.text: MSI1 encodes RNA-binding protein Musashi homolog 1. Annotated molecular activities include protein homodimerization activity and molecular condensate scaffold activity. It participates in epithelial cell differentiation and nervous system development.
